_comment: EPM-3 synthetic smoke: self-contained end-to-end run on a generated corpus with a planted RECOVERABLE process (per-tap orthogonal feature maps + true routers, tap_assignment=prior so taps.map=prior starts on the correct tap). Tier 0 is ~chance here; the trained Tier-1 adapter should reach recall@8 ~1 held-out (the model class contains the truth: r_base = hidden). Run: python3 tools/elb_train/train.py --config tools/elb_train/configs/synthetic-smoke.json --out build/epm3-synth-smoke
